title: Ulyana and the Interior
author: Lior Thornbury
blurb: Ivo Villalobos, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
